en: Black‑and‑white waterfront scene showing a small harbor filled with wooden rowing boats and sailboats in the foreground, with a town's quayside buildings and a large multi‑storey hotel or civic building behind. A flag with a Nordic cross flies above one of the buildings. The lower left corner contains the printed caption "MARSTRAND", and a small number "8642" appears in the lower right.
